summary: Cisco Systems is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Pre-Sales Cybersecurity Specialist to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will provide technical expertise, build relationships with prospective clients, and drive the growth of our cybersecurity solutions.
responsibilities: Technical Expertise: Demonstrating a deep understanding of cybersecurity principles, industry trends, and best practices.
Solution Presentations: Collaborating with the sales team to deliver compelling presentations and demonstrations of our cybersecurity offerings.
Relationship Building: Establishing positive relationships with prospective clients, including key stakeholders and decision-makers.
Requirements Gathering: Conducting detailed assessments of client needs, challenges, and existing cybersecurity frameworks.

Collaboration and Support: Collaborating with cross-functional teams, including product management, engineering, and marketing, to provide input on product development, market trends, and customer feedback.
required_skills: Strong knowledge of cybersecurity concepts, technologies, and best practices.
Excellent presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Ability to understand and address the outstanding needs of diverse clients, integrating diversity and inclusion into cybersecurity solutions.
Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to think critically and provide innovative solutions.
nice_to_have_skills: Industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or CCSP
